page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-80GB-1xRTXPRO6000 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 16 vCPUs and 16 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9555 processor running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system features shared CPU allocation, 80.0 GB of system memory providing 5.0 GB per core, and a dedicated NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU equipped with 96 GB of VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance type, and virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in single-core operations, with stress-ng single-core CPU, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded compression tests placing in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks is also highly efficient, registering 444.94 GB/sec for read operations and 279.59 GB/sec for write operations, both in the top tier. Large-model LLM inference benchmarks show strong capabilities, with prompt processing for medium 7B models reaching 8554.23 tokens per second and text generation reaching 234.73 tokens per second. Multi-core CPU performance and database operations fall into the average category.

Given the presence of a high-capacity 96 GB VRAM GPU alongside a moderate 16-vCPU allocation, this server offers a specialized hardware profile optimized for GPU-heavy tasks rather than general-purpose multi-core scaling. The resource density is highly favorable for workloads that require substantial graphics memory but do not demand dedicated CPU cores. It is well-suited for machine learning inference, small-to-medium LLM execution, image processing, and single-threaded data decompression tasks.
